stem: Based on her yearlong observations of the crew, Zeig most likely believes that the women of Apache 8 have —

options.label: A
options.text: improved the crew’s reputation by allowing men to join the all-female crew

options.label: B
options.text: significantly changed the strategies involved in fighting and preventing forest fires

options.label: C
options.text: positively affected the way people view women working in traditionally male professions

options.label: D
options.text: brought a needed enthusiasm to the firefighting community
